about_the_game:
Gameplay

Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum is a fast-paced Roguelite Arena FPS. Where survival is only the beginning.

Adapt to the Encounter! Fight your way through relentless waves of enemies through Magic Crystals. Single use mystical artifacts that reward you with randomized weapons or powerups. However they aren’t permanent, you can’t depend on a single weapon forever.

Upgrade yourself! You’re a Soul Catcher, Through the death of your enemies you earn Soul Essence. A powerful element to use in passive or gameplay changing upgrades that can make or destroy a run.

Infinite Chances! Your powers are not limited to the arena, it also allows you to come back to life after dying, Retainining some of your power to spend on permanent upgrades and grow stronger each run.

  • Dynamic Playstyle - To survive the coliseum, you must be fast and quick witted, jump, slide, dash, block or parry your way through diverse and numerous encounters.

  • Magic Crystals - Powerful artifacts that grant the user a weapon, power up or a sustainability item to help in battle, but be careful, for they are single use.

  • Diverse Enemies - Fight against different types of enemies, ranging from Cursed participants, Spitfires, Brutes, Dogbeasts and much more.

  • Evolve & Endure - Your power is not limited to obtaining run upgrades, but also powerful permanent ones, You grow stronger each time you resurrect.

  • Unique Arenas - Never fight in the same arena twice in a run, each Zone and Level offers distinct environments and ways to fight against the enemy.

  • Uncover the Story- Engage with a fully voice-acted cast whose reactions shift with your success or failure. Each interaction reveals the layers of a fallen world.

  • Obtain your Freedom - Rise through the zones of the coliseum by fighting and surviving against the Empress’s Lackeys, for a chance to confront her personally. 

  • Original Soundtrack - Each arena pulses with its own unique mood and tone, reflected in a dynamic soundtrack that evolves with your journey.

Set in the Dark Ages, the world is undergoing a crisis. A great plague has appeared, infecting every unfortunate human, because of this, a division is created to differentiate between the sane and the sick, The Common and Cursed system. Thanks to this, the Cursed are persecuted, killed or used as slaves in an ever growing unfair system.

Play as Servan, a person classified as Cursed and a prisoner of The Moon Coliseum. A place in which Cursed people and monsters are pitted against each other to fight to the death for the entertainment of the Common, all with the hope to survive another day and obtain the freedom that Empress Zephyra, enabler of this macabre game, swears to give.

In a world so cruel, Servan is given hope once again, when he discovers he’s a Soul Catcher, a special type of mage that can absorb the souls of the recently deceased and use their powers as his own. With this, Servan is given a second chance to regain his freedom and dismantle this sick place once and for all.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: I5 or Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 or RX 580
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: I7 or Ryzen 7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 4060 or AMD RX 7600
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Soul Catcher: The Moon Coliseum is a fast-paced Roguelite FPS. Where survival is just the start. Thrown into a brutal Arena of escalating enemy waves, you’ll need more than reflexes to survive, you’ll need strategy, adaptability, and the power of Magic Crystals.
